To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed a new thermal AWG module of hybrid materials for DWDM application.
the thermal effects of hybrid materials employed in a thermal planar planar AWG module for DWDM applications have been investigated deeply and parametric.
the thermal planar AWGs are suitable for the DWDM application and the hybrid materials used for the fabrication of the AWG are very effective in reducing the temperature dependence of the AWG.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of thermal planar AWGs for DWDM application.
the thermal effects in a planar arrayed-waveguide grating with hybrid materials.
a thermal AWG of hybrid material.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the thermal planar AWGs are very promising devices for DWDM application.
the thermal AWG of hybrid material is the best choice for dense wavelength division DWDM multiplexing applications.
the thermal AWG module of hybrid materials has been proposed for DWDM technique and it is a good candidate for DWDM technique.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the thermal effects of different materials used in the fabrication of the AWG is studied parametrically for a good performance of the AWG.
the proposed thermal AWG module is a very attractive candidate for DWDM application.
a thermal planar hybrid AWG module is a very promising device for dense wavelength division applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the thermal AWG module can be used as an effective multiplexing tool in the DWDM technique.
the thermal planar AWGs of different hybrid materials can be used as an efficient device for the DWDM application.
the hybrid material based thermal AWG can be used for DWDM applications in future optical communication system.
